status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_VERIFIED: The section's reusable mechanism is present and has current, inspectable verification. It is not a claim of professional generalization.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some relevant mechanism or evidence exists, but the directive's full behavioral requirement remains unproven.
status_definitions.EXTERNAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Further progress depends on an explicit human or external review rather than an agent assumption.
status_definitions.DEFERRED_BY_PRIORITY: The work is intentionally postponed by the live priority rule and is not represented as complete.

requirements.title: Mission
requirements.current_boundary: The typed loop and evidence infrastructure exist, but unseen-reference professional modeling has not been demonstrated repeatedly.
requirements.next_step: Complete a human-authorized Level-1 reference prop through independent review and retain the correction trail.

requirements.title: Precedence and scope
requirements.current_boundary: This verifies the repository policy and its documentation cross-references, not future operator compliance.
requirements.next_step: Apply the precedence check during each substantive session and reconcile new contradictory evidence.

requirements.title: Session start
requirements.current_boundary: The checklist and repository audit are available; a live Blender connection is only inspected when the task needs one.
requirements.next_step: Record live Blender identity and state before the next authorized scene mutation.

requirements.title: Professional modeling judgment
requirements.current_boundary: The C38 and magnifying-glass attempts were purged after failed or overclaimed visual results. Historical prose records human acceptance of later mallet and mug-handle trust exercises, but those build and review directories were also deliberately deleted and are explicitly excluded from active evidence by the 2026-08-21 foundation status correction. The retained operator, topology-transfer, and shading experiments demonstrate bounded techniques only. No currently retained reviewer-accepted unfamiliar asset proves professional modeling judgment.
requirements.next_step: Complete the frozen evaluator calibration. After the modeling hold is cleared, apply retained construction rules to an unfamiliar reference and preserve the full independent human-review evidence instead of relying on deleted historical records.

requirements.title: Modeling stages
requirements.current_boundary: The state machine and evidence gate are verified in controlled work; artistic stage judgment remains partial under Section 4.
requirements.next_step: Use the gate for the next human-authorized reference-modeling run.

requirements.title: Component and strategy planning
requirements.current_boundary: The Stanley run now proves structured component planning against a saved live asset without forcing every semantic component into a separate primitive: body, base, and gasket bind to distinct valid nonempty persistent regions on one connected Vessel mesh, while the removable CapCup remains a separate object. This is one neutral rotational target, not broad complex-target transfer or human acceptance.
requirements.next_step: Carry the same explicit object-versus-semantic-region strategy through a less rotational target and obtain human review of the decomposition.

requirements.title: Planner contract
requirements.current_boundary: The planner contract is verified in controlled work. Stanley retains mismatch-to-local-edit cycles, and the bounded crate reproduction retains a render-driven latch-symmetry correction before freezing as a 6.8/10 non-pass. Repeated adaptive use on visually accepted assets is still sparse.
requirements.next_step: Apply the same bounded diagnose-and-correct loop to a different I0 lesson with a clearly inspectable creator result.

requirements.title: Closed-loop execution
requirements.current_boundary: The typed observe-diagnose-decide-verify loop and fail-closed runner are verified. The crate run adds a real report-serialization correction, explicit discard of uncertain pending sessions, a render-driven symmetry correction, and fresh-process verification. Technical validity still does not establish likeness.
requirements.next_step: Use short decision transactions in the next I0 reproduction and stop at the fixed assessment/transfer cutoff.

requirements.title: State authority and recovery
requirements.current_boundary: State/rollback behavior is verified for the tested operation surface, not every arbitrary Blender edit.
requirements.next_step: Extend coverage only when a new sanctioned operation needs additional state fidelity.

requirements.title: Persistent geometry and semantics
requirements.current_boundary: Identity and semantic regions cover the tested operations. Duplicate Selection now assigns new persistent IDs to copied elements before fitted-face separation, making the identity discontinuity explicit; its curved-shell transfer passes fresh verification.
requirements.next_step: Add operation-specific tests only when newly sanctioned operations require them.

requirements.title: Separate truth channels
requirements.current_boundary: Base/evaluated/visual/technical channels are available, but their outputs still require informed interpretation.
requirements.next_step: Use all relevant channels in the next asset review rather than treating a technical pass as visual approval.

requirements.title: Reference modeling and perception
requirements.current_boundary: Projection authority, segmentation integrity, bounded semantic fitting, repeated critic consensus, controlled perception regression, and a three-target immutable rejection regression now pass. A separate four-case human-calibration package is frozen before review. None of these proves hidden-form inference, professional judgment, or accepted unfamiliar modeling.
requirements.next_step: Obtain the frozen external human calibration without tuning its decisions, then keep the hold active on any disagreement.

requirements.title: Research and knowledge lifecycle
requirements.current_boundary: Source observation, bounded episode review, transfer experiments, and retrieval infrastructure exist. The crate study links full audiovisual extraction and an independent transcript check to a typed reproduction and different-geometry transfer, while preserving the 6.8/10 fidelity failure instead of promoting it.
requirements.next_step: Repeat natural retrieval on unrelated reference failures and measure whether the retrieved rule improves visual outcomes, not only intent completeness.

requirements.title: Controlled experiments and retrieval
requirements.current_boundary: CORRECTED 2026-08-19 by audit. Circular runtime validations remain withdrawn except for the independently classified bevel-parity path. The crate study adds a controlled curved-shell transfer of fitted duplicate/separate geometry; that transfer passes technically while the source reproduction remains a visible non-pass, preserving the distinction between transferable operation and artistic result.
requirements.next_step: Repeat the observation -> retrieval -> typed action -> visual consequence chain on an unrelated target and retain failures when retrieval is inapplicable.

requirements.title: Quality and completion
requirements.current_boundary: Production high/low packaging, seam-directed UV transfer, bakes, exports, and quality checks are demonstrated across controlled cases, but no reviewer-accepted production asset establishes full transfer.
requirements.next_step: Apply the complete quality checklist to an approved prop and preserve live, unapplied modifier stacks.

requirements.title: Evaluation and anti-fake-progress rules
requirements.current_boundary: The project preserves explicit rejections, blocks automated-only success, passes strict controlled and real-target rejection regressions, and now freezes three neutral model cases plus a positive control before external review. The critic remains fallible and cannot grant acceptance; no accepted unfamiliar asset supports a capability claim.
requirements.next_step: Score the frozen human response without changing prompts or expected decisions; preserve any disagreement as evaluator failure.

requirements.title: Reporting
requirements.current_boundary: Markdown/JSON report structure and evidence navigation exist; HTML approval boards were removed by direct user instruction. Individual reports remain limited to what was actually measured.
requirements.next_step: Update authoritative Markdown/JSON current-state records after substantive sessions without reintroducing HTML approval gates.

requirements.title: Tool architecture: Cloudglue and the Blender Connector (2026-08-13)
requirements.current_boundary: Portable local ingestion and native range-scoped Gemini analysis are implemented with identity, absolute-time, and independent-review controls; TubeAlfred and other optional connectors are not available or assumed authoritative in this environment.
requirements.next_step: Use connector output only as source observation and formalize any mutation needed for evidence through the typed runtime.

requirements.title: Continuation directive reconciliation (2026-08-14)
requirements.current_boundary: The directive's Level-1-first correction is adopted; advanced curriculum and sculpt specialization remain intentionally deferred.
requirements.next_step: Build breadth across simple, structurally distinct authorized props before returning to Level-5-plus complexity.

requirements.title: Current development rule
requirements.current_boundary: The 2026-09-01 system-repair hold blocks new construction. Automated camera, mask, critic-consensus, perception, and three-target rejection regressions pass; the frozen human-calibration package awaits external judgment. Earlier I0 and major-form results remain bounded evidence, not professional capability.
requirements.next_step: Complete the frozen external calibration first. Resume only after the repository-wide hold is honestly cleared; then require repeated unrelated multi-view passes before any generalization claim.
